mapper.select: select r.PBC_PROD_ID prodid ,r.REGIST_SEQNO registseqno, ifnull(r.HIGH_YIELD_ISSUE,0) prodprofit1,ifnull(r.LOW_YIELD_ISSUE,0) prodprofit2 from pbc_prd_baseinfo_sub r where (r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS !='03' or r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS is null) and DATE_FORMAT(r.STATUS_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d')<=DATE_FORMAT(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')

select r.PBC_PROD_ID prodid ,r.REGIST_SEQNO registseqno,r.CCY, ifnull(r.PROFIT,0) prodprofit1,ifnull(r.CUSTOM_PROFIT,0) custprofit1 from PBC_PRD_BASEINFO_END_SUB r where (r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS !='03' or r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS is null) and DATE_FORMAT(r.STATUS_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d')<=DATE_FORMAT(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')

select r.PBC_PROD_ID prodid ,r.REGIST_SEQNO registseqno,r.CCY, ifnull(r.PROFIT,0) prodprofit1,ifnull(r.CUSTOM_PROFIT,0) custprofit1 from PBC_PRD_BASEINFO_END_SUB_New r where (r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS !='03' or r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS is null) and DATE_FORMAT(r.STATUS_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d')<=DATE_FORMAT(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')

select r.PBC_PROD_ID prodid ,r.REGIST_SEQNO registseqno,f.OPERATE_MODE operateMode, r.RAISING_DATE raisingDate,f.VDATE vdate, r.CUSTOMER_TYPE1 customerType,f.CUSTOMER_TYPE customerType1,ifnull(r.RAISING_AMTSUM,0) prodprofit1 from PBC_PROD_RAISING_SUB r left join pbc_prd_baseinfo_sub f on f.PBC_PROD_ID=r.PBC_PROD_ID where (r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS !='03' or r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS is null) /** and f.OPERATE_MODE in ('4','5') AND DATE_FORMAT(RAISING_DATE,'yyyy-MM')!=DATE_FORMAT(f.VDATE,'yyyy-MM')**/ and DATE_FORMAT(r.STATUS_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d')<=DATE_FORMAT(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')

select r.PROD_ID prodid ,r.REGIST_SEQNO registseqno, IFNULL(r.HIGH_YIELD_ISSUE,0) prodprofit1,IFNULL(r.LOW_YIELD_ISSUE,0) prodprofit2 from pbc_prd_baseinfo_sub_new r where (r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS !='03' or r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS is null) and DATE_FORMAT(r.STATUS_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d')<=DATE_FORMAT(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
